change_summary: Fixed queued old Pause events canceling a new Play while it waits for the shared lock. The controller now tracks whether the current attempt has called audio.play(); pause events during the ownership wait are ignored, while a genuine current media pause still stops audio and releases ownership. Fixed and country resource URIs advanced to radio-v6 and country-v4, with README and delivered-resource assertions updated.
decisions: Kept the Web Lock and BroadcastChannel ownership protocol unchanged; the repair is confined to controller event handling and resource version references.
Preserved the prior active-media pause guard: a current paused element after audio.play() stops and releases the lock, while a queued pause during a lock wait cannot cancel the user's new Play.
